alex.k: Quick check — need a final decision on 429 + quota header shape for per-route rollout. Here's my proposal, want it stable and SDK-friendly.

maria: can you paste the exact header examples? also add what SDK fields we'd map to.

alex.k: proposed headers (short):

X-Quota-Bucket: uploads:scope:1
X-Quota-Remaining: 37
X-Quota-Reset: 1768703600   # unix epoch seconds
X-Burst-Tokens: 5
Retry-After: 30              # keep for backcompat

SDK mapping: rateLimit.bucket, rateLimit.remaining, rateLimit.reset, rateLimit.burstLeft. Keep Retry-After as fallback.

sahil: If X-Quota-Remaining missing (eg aggregated fallback) do we return 429 with body hint? some clients only parse JSON.

maria: yes include minimal body hint:
{ "error": "quota_exceeded", "quota_hint": { "bucket": "uploads:scope:1", "remaining": 0 } }

jen: mobile SDKs expect X-Rate-Limit-Remaining. Do we alias server-side or deprecate? cc @ryan

ryan: emit both X-Rate-Limit-Remaining and X-Quota-Remaining for 90 days, add X-Quota-Format-Version: 1. Start warning header at day 60. We'll add metric to count old-header usage.

alex.k: timeline: both for 90d, warning at 60d. canary in staging to verify. will lock spec at 5pm PT if no objections.

sahil: tests needed: 429 w/ headers; 429 w/ body-hint; 200 responses include X-Quota-Remaining; SDKs parse alias preferring new one. I'll open test ticket.

jen: action items:
- jen -> update OpenAPI + PR with header examples (today)
- ryan -> canary + metrics (this week)
- sahil -> tests + SDK mapping PR by EOD Fri
- maria -> support note for customers seeing both headers

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy to staging at 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z :rocket:

alex.k: ping this thread when PRs are up. speak now if you want different header names; otherwise locking spec at 5pm PT.
